verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a personal AI agent, but the evidence never documents a capability to act on many items at once. The closest items are task-specific: auditing subscriptions and cancelling unneeded ones, with per-action approval. There is also the general ability to write code and build tools, which is a building block rather than a documented bulk-operation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
